## Tarea 2. Bull Spread

## Detalles de las posiciones
```{r}

# Variables de las posiciones

strike_prc_1 <- 88.50       # Strike de la Call comprada
call_prc_1 <- 3.36          # Prima pagada por la Call comprada

strike_prc_2 <- 89.75       # Strike de la Call vendida
call_prc_2 <- 2.79          # Prima recibida por la Call vendida

# Tamaño del contrato de WTI West Texas Crude Oil

contract_size <- 1000       # número de barriles

# Rango de precios del futuro al vencimiento

future_prc_range <- seq(
  from = 80,
  to = 100,
  by = 0.1
)
```

## Análisis de ganancia/pérdida
```{r}
# Prima neta pagada por barril

net_premium <- call_prc_1 - call_prc_2


# Call comprada (Long Call)

bought_call_profit <-
  pmax(
    future_prc_range - strike_prc_1,
    0
  ) - call_prc_1


# Call vendida (Short Call)

sold_call_profit <-
  call_prc_2 -
  pmax(
    future_prc_range - strike_prc_2,
    0
  )


# Resultado total del Bull Call Spread

bull_spread_profit <-
  bought_call_profit +
  sold_call_profit
```

# Indicadores de la estrategia Bull Spread
```{r}

# Punto de equilibrio

breakeven <-
  strike_prc_1 +
  net_premium


# Pérdida máxima por barril

max_loss <-
  -net_premium


# Ganancia máxima por barril

max_gain <-
  (strike_prc_2 - strike_prc_1) -
  net_premium


# Conversión a USD por contrato

max_loss_usd <-
  max_loss * contract_size

max_gain_usd <-
  max_gain * contract_size

```

## Resultados
```{r}

net_premium
breakeven
max_loss_usd
max_gain_usd

```

## Gráfica Bull Spread
```{r}
# Configuración de la gráfica

par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 8.1))


# Conversión de los resultados a USD por contrato

bought_call_profit_usd <-
  bought_call_profit * contract_size

sold_call_profit_usd <-
  sold_call_profit * contract_size

bull_spread_profit_usd <-
  bull_spread_profit * contract_size


# Límites de la gráfica

y_min <- min(c(
  bull_spread_profit_usd,
  bought_call_profit_usd,
  sold_call_profit_usd
))

y_max <- max(c(
  bull_spread_profit_usd,
  bought_call_profit_usd,
  sold_call_profit_usd
))

y_pad <- 0.08 * (y_max - y_min)


# Gráfica del Bull Call Spread

plot(
  x = future_prc_range,
  y = bull_spread_profit_usd,
  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  main = paste0(
    "Bull Call Spread Crude Oil (K1 = ",
    strike_prc_1,
    ", K2 = ",
    strike_prc_2,
    ", Débito = ",
    round(net_premium, 2),
    ")"
  ),
  xlab = "Precio del futuro al vencimiento (USD/barril)",
  ylab = "Ganancia/Pérdida total (USD)",
  ylim = c(
    y_min - y_pad,
    y_max + y_pad
  )
)

# Call comprada

lines(
  x = future_prc_range,
  y = bought_call_profit_usd,
  col = "blue",
  lty = 2,
  lwd = 2
)


# Call vendida

lines(
  x = future_prc_range,
  y = sold_call_profit_usd,
  col = "red",
  lty = 2,
  lwd = 2
)

# Línea horizontal en cero

abline(
  h = 0,
  col = "gray"
)


# Strike de la Call comprada

abline(
  v = strike_prc_1,
  col = "lightgray",
  lty = 2
)


# Strike de la Call vendida

abline(
  v = strike_prc_2,
  col = "lightgray",
  lty = 2
)


# Punto de equilibrio

abline(
  v = breakeven,
  col = "darkgreen",
  lty = 3,
  lwd = 2
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(
    "Portafolio (Bull Call Spread)",
    "Call (Long K1)",
    "Call (Short K2)",
    "Breakeven"
  ),
  lty = c(
    1,
    2,
    2,
    3
  ),
  lwd = c(
    2,
    2,
    2,
    2
  ),
  col = c(
    "black",
    "blue",
    "red",
    "darkgreen"
  ),
  box.lty = 0
)

```
